articles.title: AbbVie’s US$100b Pledge Raises Questions On Value, Margins And Debt
articles.mainIdea: AbbVie’s US$100b Pledge Raises Questions On Value, Margins And Debt
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: AbbVie’s US$100b Pledge Raises Questions On Value, Margins And Debt. AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) has entered a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government to commit US$100b to U.S. research and development and capital investments over the next decade. The company is also launching a three year effort focused on lowering drug prices while expanding U.S. manufacturing and direct to patient care access.
